Manifest.Name: 酒瓶水瓶回收灯牌 Recyclable Bottle Neon Sign
Manifest.Author: WitchRin
Manifest.Description: 新增广告灯牌“酒瓶水瓶回收灯牌”。放进展示柜后，会吸引带着空酒瓶和空水瓶的拾荒者，一半来卖钱，一半用瓶子换食物。杰克逊博士处有售。 Adds the Recyclable Bottle Neon Sign. Put it in the display case to attract scavengers with empty wine bottles and water bottles: half sell them, half barter them for food. Sold by Dr. Jackson.
